title: Great cooking experience
text:
We had a great experience with this cooking class.  The location is in Bari Gotic which is great for strolling before and after.  

Chef Marco was excellent at explaining the meal, prep and cooking process, including engaging with two teenagers.   

Of course the food was delicious and the wine tasty too. 

Would recommend.
author: HJ2

title: Very personal.  Pamela,...
text: Very personal.  Pamela, our chef, felt like one of the family.  There was a lot of individual attention given to each person.  Every part of the experience was explained in full.
author: Roger_G

title: This was a delightful...
text: This was a delightful experience. Our chef was Marco. He had great experiences to share with our group while keeping us on task. The food was excellent and the recipes were ours to take home. I always love a cooking class to get to know the real culture of an area. This one did not disappoint!
author: Vanessa_J

title: Such a fun and...
text: Such a fun and educational experience! The food was delicious, and the wine throughout the class was fantastic. I loved learning new recipes and techniques and can’t wait to recreate some of the dishes at home. Highly recommend!
author: Jordan_L

title: Wonderful time at Cook & Taste Barcelona!
text: We had a wonderful time at Cook & Taste Barcelona.  The chef, Carlos, was friendly and provided great instruction.  We made roasted veggies with Romesco sauce and tortilla (egg & potato dish) for appetizers, chicken & veggie paella and Cream Catalonia for dessert.  It was a lot of fun and the food was amazing!  There were 10 people in the class and it was great getting to know everyone.  Wine was included - which helped in the fun!  I highly recommend this class!
author: G1417XCjudithw

title: Excellent meal and activity!
text: There were six of us in our group and this was truly a highlight of our trip. Thank you so much to Carlos who was an excellent chef and teacher.
author: k_w

title: Excellent experience
text: I decided last minute to attend a cooking class, seeing great reviews about this place. Pamela was super friendly, knowledgeable, and encouraged us to participate in the interactive cooking tasks. The dinner was a 4 courses, with roasted veggie, tortilla, paella, and crema catalena. It was the best experience I had on the trip.
author: Grant_D

title: A must!
text: We were a small group of 7 people. Pleasant and participative people. Our leader was funny and she shared her cooking and Barcelona experiences. Excellent meal!
author: Famille_B

title: Fantastic experience!
text: Chef Mariana was top notch! My wife and I really enjoyed our experience and we learned how to make four dishes. Highly recommend this tour.
author: Justin_d

title: Great experience!
text: Carlos was a great teacher chef. The facility was amazing for the large group.
